name: March Madness
hook: The tournament's phrase, bracket and blue-blood moments, explained in one sitting.

facts.label: the phrase's origin
facts.statement: An Illinois sports official wrote in 1939 that 'a little March Madness' may 'contribute to sanity'; Brent Musburger made it the men's tournament's name.

facts.label: a bracket
facts.statement: Filling out a bracket is the March Madness office ritual, and a 14-letter expert who picks for fans is a bracketologist.

facts.label: the Elite Eight
facts.statement: The Elite Eight is the round before the Final Four — the third-to-last round of the tournament.

facts.label: Madison Square Garden
facts.statement: Early on, the NIT at Madison Square Garden was a bigger deal than the NCAA tournament.

facts.label: Kansas
facts.statement: Kansas, the Midwestern hoops powerhouse, beat North Carolina in a 2022 March Madness title thriller.

facts.label: Michael Jordan
facts.statement: Michael Jordan hit a championship winner for North Carolina against Georgetown in 1982 and was named an all-time March Madness player in 2013.

facts.label: Gonzaga
facts.statement: Gonzaga, the Catholic liberal arts college in Spokane, is a regular March Madness contender.
